snippet.title: Bylina - Release Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Add Bylina to wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2461440/Bylina

Key Features:
- A unique take on mythology, blending dark fantasy with sharp humor, unexpected twists, and a few deliberately ridiculous surprises along the way.
- Skill-based real-time combat: outsmart mythical foes using precise timing, movement, and a mix of special abilities, weapons, and spells.
- Build the Hero your way: shape the character with nonlinear progression, spells, unique skills, and bizarre gear found in the darkest corners of the realm.
- A semi-open world full of secrets: discover interconnected regions, hidden dungeons, and side quests woven into rich lore.

Join on Discord → https://discord.gg/bylinagame
Follow on X → https://twitter.com/bylinagame
Watch on TikTok → https://www.tiktok.com/@bylina_game
Explore on Instagram → https://instagram.com/bylina.game
